editor.summary: Wrote a re-runnable Playwright editor-task matrix (tools/editor-matrix.mjs, chromium 1440x900, logs in as admin/admin) that performs all 14 required editor tasks through wp-admin, proves each on the frontend with a plain HTTP fetch of the rendered page (curl-equivalent, parsed with cheerio), reverts every change through the UI (Revisions restore / re-selecting the original value / deleting created records) and compares the end state with a WP-CLI snapshot. Final result: 14 pass, 0 fail, 0 blocked, 0 end-state differences. Report: docs/reports/editor-matrix.md (steps / expected / observed / screenshots / result per task, usability findings, site-state comparison); 34 screenshots under docs/reports/screenshots/admin/em-NN-*.png. Two plugin bugs surfaced (blank icon previews in every Icon field; the Header settings tab drops header.cta_link.label on every save) plus five usability findings (WP core revision-restore redirect + no new revision on meta-only restore, autosave notice after preview, story card heading = veteran display name, new Person defaults to Order 0 and jumps to first position, sticky "Save Menu" button click not registering in a specific scroll geometry). Site verified identical at the end with WP-CLI: About/Home section meta, titles/slugs/content, hk9_settings (byte-identical to the option read at session start), 7 primary menu items, story/event/person/partner/submission lists, no "tmp Editor Matrix" records, Mailpit empty, no autosaves, admin editor preferences put back. Only revision counts grew (About 1 → 23, Home 1 → 29, all from this verifier's iterations; the original revisions 1531/1535 are intact) — allowed by the brief. No git commit/checkout was performed.

editor.integration_notes: Run: `node tools/editor-matrix.mjs` (all 14 tasks, ~4 min) or `--only=7,8` for a subset (merged into the previous results via docs/reports/screenshots/admin/editor-matrix-results.json so the report always lists all 14); `--headed` to watch; `--reset-rate-limit` deletes the hk9_form_rl_* transient before task 14. Options: --base, --mailpit, --out, --report, --user, --pass. Exit code 1 on any FAIL. Dependencies already in package.json (playwright, cheerio); uses tools/wp.sh for WP-CLI. The script purges leftover 'tmp Editor Matrix' records from an interrupted run, restores page meta / hk9_settings with WP-CLI if a UI revert did not leave the original value (reported per task), restores the admin user's wp_persisted_preferences, and re-normalises the raw hk9_settings option after Settings-API saves (effective values are compared via Store::all()). Suggested fixes for the two plugin bugs: hook `hk9/fields/icon_symbol_prefix` to return 'hk9-icon-' (theme inc/icons.php or plugin Renderer default), and carry the existing label through Settings\\Store::sanitize_link / the settings link field (add a hidden label input or merge the stored label when the posted value lacks one). No git operations were performed; docs/reports/editor-matrix.md and tools/editor-matrix.mjs are untracked additions.

audits.summary:
Audit runner completed all 9 steps against http://localhost:8093 (session 17:04–17:40 UTC). Results: URL matrix 82/82 ✅ with fixtures (and 81/81 ✅ after cleanup); axe-core 4.13 over 23 URLs × 2 widths: zero serious/critical violations in first-party markup (the only 6 hits are inside the YouTube iframe of the local-only fixture post); network audit 23/24 URLs clean, every first-party page served solely from localhost:8093 (the single flag is the fixture post's YouTube embed: fonts.gstatic.com inside the frame + Chromium's 'web-share' allow-attribute warning from WP core's oEmbed markup); cross-engine (Chromium 153 / WebKit 26.6 / Firefox 155, Playwright 1.63.0): 24 captures, page heights within 6px, no font/form-control/hero-crop differences beyond text rasterisation and the native textarea grip; Lighthouse 12.8.2 + Chrome 152 mobile (simulate, Slow 4G): Performance 84/87/87/91/90/87/87 for / , /about/, /program/, /contact/, /news/, /fixture-rich-blocks/, /barkode/hk923-005/ (a11y 100 everywhere; SEO 69 on the two intentionally-noindexed URLs), desktop 99 and 100; keyboard walk 19/19 checks pass with screenshots; debug.log contains only the 2 pre-session lines from another agent's contact-form test while Mailpit was restarting; fixtures deleted and site back to 0 posts / admin-only.

Real findings (theme/plugin, reported not edited): (1) fonts download twice on every page — inc/assets.php preloads fraunces-var.woff2?v=… and inter-var.woff2?v=… but @font-face requests the same files without ?v=, wasting 106 KB per page and delaying LCP; (2) render-blocking 173 KB (28 KB gz) theme.css is the main mobile-performance cost (est. 1.46–1.62 s per page); (3) .hk9-btn:focus-visible (_buttons.scss:35-38) replaces the 2px outline with a 1px navy ring that is invisible on dark sections (hero CTAs). Tool bugs fixed: axe.mjs (full selector details, in-iframe attribution, axe/browser versions), network-audit.mjs (document 404 counted as failed request; pageerror listener leak; requests from the previous page's embeds leaking into the next URL via shared page; main-frame vs embedded-frame attribution), lighthouse.mjs (versions/throttling/per-run scores, --desktop, automatic HTML diagnostic + opportunities for perf<90, --reuse, correct multi-output file naming, alt-text masking and full privacy scrubbing for /barkode/ runs), and docker/fixtures/blog-fixtures.php (fixtures delete removed the imported 'Poker Run'/'Veterans Day' tags because pre-existing terms adopted via term_exists were marked as fixtures — fixed, tags restored by slug, verified with importer dry-run and a second create/delete cycle).

issues: THEME (not edited) — fonts download twice on every page: theme/heartland-k9s/inc/assets.php:79-81 (hk9_preload_fonts) preloads assets/fonts/fraunces-var.woff2?v=<mtime> and inter-var.woff2?v=<mtime>, but the compiled @font-face src in assets/dist/theme.css is url("../fonts/fraunces-var.woff2") / inter-var.woff2 without the query, so the preloads never match and both fonts are fetched again at VeryHigh priority (network-requests on all 8 Lighthouse URLs: 5 font requests, 106 KB wasted, competing with the LCP image on Slow 4G). Fix: use identical URLs in the preload and @font-face.

THEME (not edited) — mobile Lighthouse Performance 84–87 on /, /about/, /program/, /fixture-rich-blocks/, /barkode/hk923-005/ (contact 91, news 90): render-blocking theme.css (173 KB raw / 28 KB gz; est. 1.46–1.62 s per page, ~23 KB unused per page), the double font fetch above, and image delivery (crest PNG Concept-1-rocker-outlined-2-263x300.png 68 KB served for an 80 px logo in header and footer; hero/feature JPEGs 108–119 KB not in WebP/AVIF). Desktop is 99–100 so the gap is purely bandwidth/RTT-bound. Details + estimates in docs/reports/lighthouse/summary.md.

THEME (not edited) — .hk9-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--hk9-ring) } (assets/src/scss/_buttons.scss:35-38, ring = --hk9-primary #1c2f4a) overrides the generic 2 px outline with a 1 px navy ring that is imperceptible on dark sections: the focused hero CTA 'Support a Service Dog' is visually identical to its unfocused state (docs/reports/screenshots/keyboard/zoom-hero-cta.png; computed styles confirm the only change is that shadow). Fails the intent of WCAG 2.4.7/2.4.13 for every .hk9-btn on a navy background. Suggested: two-tone ring (0 0 0 2px var(--hk9-bg), 0 0 0 4px var(--hk9-ring)) or don't override the outline.

The two tags were recreated by slug (new ids 89/90); the importer map still lists 72/73 until the next real import pass adopts them by slug (dry-run confirms 0 create/0 update/6 skip). Other agents running fixtures create/delete before this fix may have removed those tags earlier in the day too.
Local Apache serves /wp-content/uploads/* without Cache-Control (Lighthouse cache-insight, 612 KB on /). Hosting-level; verify on the production server, not a theme issue.

Known/documented exceptions, not defects: /fixture-rich-blocks/ (LOCAL-ONLY) YouTube embed causes the only axe serious/critical hits (inside the iframe), the only network-audit flag (fonts.gstatic.com + doubleclick inside the frame, Chromium 'web-share' warning from WP core's oEmbed allow attribute), Best Practices 96 (third-party cookie) and CLS 0.050; SEO 69 on /barkode/hk923-005/ and the fixture post is the intentional noindex in theme/heartland-k9s/inc/compat.php:181-190.

security.verdict: PASS with fixes recommended. No critical or high findings. The plugin's security posture is strong: every privileged REST route, admin-post action and AJAX handler has a capability check plus nonce; ZIP unpacking is contained and de-scripted; SQL is prepared or via native APIs; output is escaped; no secrets, debug tools or PII dumps ship in the distributable (tests/ is excluded by tools/package.mjs). One medium-severity abuse vector exists on the unauthenticated no-JS form path (unbounded transient creation) and four low-severity hardening items.

findings.issue: handle_admin_post() writes an error-state transient (hk9_form_res_<random>, 2 wp_options rows, 5-min TTL) for EVERY failed POST, including nonce-less/honeypot/token failures from anonymous visitors, and failures are not rate-limited (record_send only counts successes). Expired rows are only garbage-collected by daily cron (core + Submissions::purge_expired_transients). Confirmed: 3 anonymous POSTs to admin-post.php?action=hk9_form_submit with no nonce created 3 transients (rows 0 -> 3). A bot hammering that URL can bloat wp_options by millions of rows per day (DB DoS).
findings.fix: For outcomes in NO_VALUE_CODES (unknown_form, nonce, honeypot, token, expired) skip set_transient and redirect with a stateless `&code=<code>` query arg that render() maps to the canned message; only persist state for validation/duplicate/send_failed results that passed nonce+token. Additionally count failed attempts in the per-IP limiter (e.g. a separate hk9_form_fail_ key, 429 after N/hour).

findings.issue: unpack_upload() extracts first, then purge_scripts() deletes PHP/JS/SVG/dotfiles and rewrites .htaccess. A ZIP carrying its own .htaccess (+ a .php file) overwrites the deny file for the window between unzip_file() and purge. Exposure is small (manage_options only, 32-char random dir, Apache deny restored, nginx unaffected), and .html files are still left under uploads/.
findings.fix: Pre-scan the archive with ZipArchive before extracting and refuse any entry whose basename starts with '.' or whose extension is in SCRIPT_EXTENSIONS (add 'html'); or extract into a temp dir outside the web root (get_temp_dir()) and move only the manifest/content/media trees into uploads after purge.

findings.issue: With advanced.purge_on_uninstall enabled, uploads/hk9-import/*.log, any leftover uploads/hk9-payload-* directory (which can contain the entire site payload including registry records) and the per-user hk9 dismiss user-meta are not removed.
findings.fix: In the purge branch, use WP_Filesystem to delete wp_upload_dir()['basedir'].'/hk9-import' and every 'hk9-payload-*' directory, and call delete_metadata('user', 0, '<DISMISS_META key>', '', true).

findings.issue: test() performs the admin-triggered self HEAD request with 'sslverify' => false (line 236). Not exploitable by visitors (admin cap + nonce, target is home_url()), but it silently accepts MITM'd TLS on production.
findings.fix: Remove 'sslverify' => false (or make it `apply_filters('hk9/redirects/test_sslverify', true)` so local Docker can opt out).

findings.issue: Line 385: the repeater summary does `div.innerHTML = ctl.value` on a detached element to extract text from a richtext field. `` handlers execute even on detached nodes. Stored values are wp_kses_post-filtered so this is self-XSS only, but it is an unnecessary HTML sink.
findings.fix: Use `new DOMParser().parseFromString(ctl.value, 'text/html').body.textContent` (DOMParser documents are inert and do not run handlers).

spot_checks: REST permissions (curl, anonymous): GET/POST hk9/v1/import/{status,start,rollback} -> 401 hk9_forbidden; GET hk9/v1/pick?type=hk9_barkode -> 401; wp/v2/hk9_barkode and wp/v2/hk9_submission -> 404 (not in REST; Meta/Registry::in_rest returns false for hk9_barkode; Submissions show_in_rest=false, create_posts=do_not_allow).

Import REST (src/Import/Rest.php): every route manage_options; start/step additionally require unfiltered_html; rollback requires confirm=ROLLBACK and run id sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9-]; payload path validated by realpath against allow-list (uploads/hk9-payload-* only unless HK9_LOCAL_DEV).

admin-post handlers: hk9_import_upload / hk9_import_log -> manage_options + check_admin_referer (anonymous request -> 400, no handler for nopriv); hk9_form_submit is intentionally public; POST-only, redirects via wp_safe_redirect, hk9_success override constrained by wp_validate_redirect (no open redirect).

ZIP handling (Payload::unpack_upload): only .zip via sanitize_file_name + wp_check_filetype_and_ext; core unzip_file() applies validate_file() (blocks ../, absolute paths, no symlinks); random 32-char directory; .htaccess 'Require all denied' + index.html; purge of php/php3-8/phtml/phar/cgi/pl/py/sh/js/mjs/svg/htm/shtml + all dotfiles; earlier uploads removed. Verified http://localhost:8093/wp-content/uploads/hk9-import/ and /.htaccess -> 403 on Apache.
Log download (Import\Admin::handle_log): manage_options + nonce, run id sanitized, Payload::resolve_within() containment, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, attachment disposition with rawurlencode.

Forms anti-abuse (Antispam.php): nonce + honeypot + HMAC-signed timestamp (3s..6h) + atomic single-use token (wp_cache_add / add_option) claimed only after validation + per-IP hourly limit; REST failures persist nothing; token endpoint is stateless (no DB growth); IP stored only as daily-salted HMAC; trusted-proxy header parsing right-to-left.
Mailer: Reply-To is the validated submitter email only; From name stripped of CR/LF/<>; email templates escape every value (esc_html/esc_url/esc_attr).

Capability model (PostTypes/Capabilities.php + user_has_cap): administrators get all hk9 caps; editor-level users get the 6 editorial types only; hk9_barkode caps for editors only when advanced.editors_manage_registry is on; hk9_view_submissions/hk9_manage_settings/hk9_run_import/hk9_manage_redirects never granted to editors. Pick endpoint filters types by per-type edit_posts and excludes hk9_submission; Fields\Access drops post references the saving user cannot edit.

Nonce/cap coverage: Meta/MetaBox::save and Sections/MetaBox::save (per-post nonce + edit_post), wp_ajax_hk9_section_panel (check_ajax_referer + edit_post + template allow-list), wp_ajax_hk9_dismiss_mail_failures (referer + can_view), Redirects admin (check_admin_referer per action/key, hk9_manage_redirects), Settings (Settings API, option_page_capability_hk9_settings, cap re-checked inside sanitize_submission, show_in_rest=false).

Sanitize/escape: Richtext -> wp_kses_post; Link -> esc_url_raw; settings 'code' (Fathom id) -> [A-Za-z0-9_-]; icon preview sanitize_key + esc_attr; admin/import JS escapes all server-derived strings via esc(); no unprepared $wpdb queries anywhere in src/ (only prepared/LIKE-escaped in Submissions::purge_expired_transients and uninstall.php).

Import safety: Options step allow-list = hk9_* plus 11 site-info options (no siteurl/home/users_can_register/default_role/admin_email); media via media_handle_sideload + get_allowed_mime_types + wp_check_filetype_and_ext; Manifest::path() uses resolve_within.

Redirect resolver: GET/HEAD only, skips admin/REST/cron/AJAX; rules are admin-written; targets esc_url_raw(http/https) or wp_sanitize_redirect; internal -> wp_safe_redirect; header value rawurlencoded; no visitor-controlled writes.
SVG: plugin never filters upload_mimes; SVGs stripped from ZIP payloads; no SVG output path other than the theme sprite <use> with escaped id.

Distributable hygiene: tools/package.mjs excludes heartland-k9s-core/tests/*; tests/*.php are gated by WP_CLI / PHP_SAPI==='cli' / HK9_LOCAL_DEV; no error_log/var_dump/print_r, no hard-coded secrets; Privacy/Registry blocks anonymous /wp/v2/users, oEmbed/sitemap for sensitive types. Uninstall keeps data by default and removes plugin caps/version options.
Probe cleanup: the 3 test transients created during the admin-post probe were deleted from wp_options (6 rows) afterwards.
